registration.notes: Front-door composition, seam 5 (FD-1 ONE_SEAM_PER_STEP, FD-9 as ruled: SCREEN_1_TYPED_REGISTRATION, LOCAL_SQLITE_UNDER_RUNTIME_VOLUME, OWNER_REF_PRESENTED_UNPROVEN, V2_AMENDMENT_TWO_OPERATIONS, REGISTER_IS_THE_ONLY_WRITE): build_studio_context receives review_service_base_url (CR-2), activation_root (seam 1), policy_registry and policy_identities (seam 2), provider_registry while UGENCE_STUDIO_SIMULATION_PROVIDER=1 (seam 3) and, when UGENCE_STUDIO_SYSTEM_REGISTRY_PATH is set, system_registry: the tenant-bound SqliteSystemRegistry (ai-system-registry 0.2.0) with registered_by = this deployment's name and version; the frozen v2 contract is amended once (v2-A1) by the two registry operations; decision_store, governance_hook and console_base_url stay absent. Supersedes the seam-3 registration, which is never edited; a later seam registers a new record superseding this one.
